properties.name: doc-engine.temp-dir
properties.description: Directory for temporary files; unset uses the system temp dir.

properties.name: doc-engine.cleanup-on-shutdown
properties.description: Delete tracked temp files on JVM shutdown.

properties.name: doc-engine.converter.libreoffice.enabled
properties.description: Whether the process-based LibreOffice converter is created.

properties.name: doc-engine.converter.libreoffice.executable
properties.description: Path to the soffice executable; unset looks it up on PATH.

properties.name: doc-engine.converter.libreoffice.timeout
properties.description: Per-conversion timeout for the process-based LibreOffice converter.

properties.name: doc-engine.converter.libreoffice.working-dir
properties.description: Working directory for the soffice process; unset uses the system temp dir.

properties.name: doc-engine.converter.jod.enabled
properties.description: Whether the pooled JODConverter is created when the module is on the classpath.

properties.name: doc-engine.converter.jod.pool-size
properties.description: Number of LibreOffice processes in the pool.

properties.name: doc-engine.converter.jod.base-port
properties.description: First local TCP port of the pool; process N listens on base-port+N. Co-located applications must use disjoint ranges.

properties.name: doc-engine.converter.jod.existing-process-action
properties.description: What to do when a process already listens on a pool port: FAIL, KILL, CONNECT or CONNECT_OR_KILL. Unset keeps the JODConverter default (KILL).

properties.name: doc-engine.converter.jod.task-timeout
properties.description: Per-task execution timeout for the pool.

properties.name: doc-engine.converter.jod.task-queue-timeout
properties.description: How long a task waits for a free process.

properties.name: doc-engine.converter.jod.max-tasks-per-process
properties.description: Restart a process after this many tasks.
